//: Regions of countries whose map is too big for one download at z15 but whose routing pack fits whole (docs/COUNTRY_REGIONS_PLAN.md, Canada and Russia): one map per region, cut by the union of its Geofabrik polygons (region-outline.py) and built by .github/workflows/country-packages.yml; the country keeps one routing pack (scripts/routing/packs.json) with its emergency points, streets, places and house numbers, downloaded with the first region. A country split this way needs that pack. Regions with a pack of their own (the USA) live in packs.json instead. The key is the map id; country: the country's id in src/features/maps/regions.json; geofabrik: the extracts whose polygons make the region. Their names are maps:parts.<id> in the app's locales. Crimea goes in ru-south without a name of its own (owner's decision, 2026-10-27).
